# kayjs-ui

> Components for kay apps, shipped as `.kay` sources the app compiles as its own and styled by the classes of one `theme.css` the app restyles: buttons, forms and inputs, dialogs, tables, navigation, layouts, charts, drag and drop, media and more.

## Topics

`bunx kay docs <words>` prints the section of these files or kay's that matches.

The rest by topic, each file read whole with one command:

- [Setup, settings and testing](llms/setup.md): installing the theme and components, the settings that map icons, testing an app that uses it
- [Icons, buttons, toasts, dialogs, cards, popovers and stats](llms/basics.md): Icon, Button, toast, Dialog, ConfirmDelete, Card, Badge, Notice, Avatar, Popover, HoverCard, TooltipHost, Stat, Meter, BarList, CopyButton, Rating
- [Inputs, selects, editors and forms](llms/forms.md): TextInput, Textarea, Select, RangeInput, Slider, ColorInput, DateInput, DateRangeInput, TimeInput, MultiSelect, Combobox, FileDrop, Menu, IconPicker, MarkdownEditor
- [Forms, FormDialog and Steps](llms/forms-and-steps.md): FormField, SaveForm, ContactForm, SubscribeForm, FormDialog and Steps, the multi-step form
- [Tables, tabs and pagination](llms/tables-navigation-and-layout.md): Table, Segmented, Tabs, TabNav, SiteNav, AppHeader, AppSwitcher, Toggle, Checkbox, Pagination, QrCode
- [Page layout, command palette and trees](llms/page-layout-palette-and-trees.md): PageHeader, PageSection, CollapsibleSection, Accordion, Widget, CardRow, SidePanel, Toolbar, SplitLayout, CommandPalette, TreeView, Timeline, Bell
- [Texts and languages](llms/words.md): the `ui.*` messages that word every default text, and the page's locale in charts
- [Charts, drag and drop, galleries and image tools](llms/charts-drag-and-media.md): LineChart, BarChart, ScatterChart, MapView, ContributionGraph, Sortable, Board, DropTargets, MediaGallery, Carousel, AudioPlayer, Masonry, WhenVisible, LoadMore, VirtualList, ZoomPane, ImageCropper

## A `style` on a root

A component's root writes its own declarations first and an app's `style` after them, as an app's `class` wins the class merge: ZoomPane, Masonry, SplitLayout, Popover, HoverCard, QrCode and Skeleton all do. A declaration the component computes to work (ZoomPane's `touch-action`, a Popover's `position-anchor`, a Skeleton's `--_skeleton-width`, a QrCode's `width`) is overridden the same way, so an app that sets one owns the result.
